title: Tech Note: Custom Log Component (R2) - Revised 5/7/2018
author: Add Komoncharoensiri – Director of Technical Services, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note's core idea — a worker-process-serialized custom logger writing simple text or JSON log files — remains a sound and still-usable pattern in modern 4D, since CALL WORKER and preemptive-safe logging are still core mechanisms today. The specific component code is classic-mode 4D (methods, no classes), so a present-day implementation would likely be rebuilt using 4D classes/singletons for the logger object.
related_updates: 4D added native class-based patterns (v17 Project Mode, v16 R6+ classes) that make encapsulating a logger singleton cleaner than the method-based component shown here
4D's built-in debug/request logs and OSW (On Server Web) logs have also evolved separately
